beats.narration: The corridor was supposed to end at a locked door. In this fictional retelling of the Dulce legend, Thomas Castello sees it open. At the far end, two figures wait beneath the lights: one small and grey, the other tall and motionless. Beyond them, a laboratory glows behind glass. A man lies inside a chamber. Beside him stands something that resembles a body, waiting. A pale light moves between the machines. Castello cannot tell what he is watching. A medical procedure? A transfer of memory? Or the impossible idea that something human could be taken from one body and placed inside another?
